digest.component_or_area: LLM structured output handling (pai_retry, pai_output integration)
propositions: Replace manual attempt scheduler in _pai_structured with one bounded Pydantic Agent operation composing S1 output-policy adapter while preserving full history and authoritative inputs

Implement HistoryProcessor wire-context projection that includes/omits failed ModelResponse based on token-fit decision: response fits wire only if input_tokens + output_tokens + effective_max_tokens <= model_window_tokens for all candidates

Add concision-aware operation guard as after_model_request capability for prompted branch only, raising ModelRetry with concision instruction on truncation signals (finish_reason in {length, max_tokens}) without parsing, while keeping NativeOutput branch with original guard_capability unchanged

Combine base request budget (ceil(eff_max_iter/2)) with output-retry allowance (OUTPUT_RETRIES value) in one UsageLimits.request_limit with no per-attempt reset, sharing one counter for both concision retries and parse/validation retries
Raise ContextWindowExceededError when authoritative input alone overflows model window without shortening any content
Preserve NativeOutput branch selection, bug-895c grammar-compilation fallback behavior, and terminal truncation handling while replacing only the manual for-loop scheduling
